AndroidOidcCompatStart.description: Existing V1 Android/Web start request; outer PKCE is separate from SDK PKCE.

AndroidScheduleResolutionRequest.description: Finalization uses an observed server evidence digest, never caller-supplied stop evidence.

definition.description: Original secret-free V1 Crew or typed V2 WorkflowDefinition JSON.

action.description: accept/decline/cancel for forms; approve_sampling/release_sample/decline_sample for model IO.

archive.description:
A complete original metadata proof from sequence zero to the frozen head.
It contains no prompts, credentials, paths, or model responses.

basis.description: provider_reported or price_calculated, never an estimated reservation.

units.description: Integer amount in 10^-scale units. Never a binary float or an invoice claim.

AuditOriginRotationPlan.description: Public original operator plan; no KMS token, wrapping plaintext or key seed.

folder.description: An exact registered external folder capability, narrowed to read-only.

predicates.description: All predicates must match. An empty list accepts every object.

AutomationWorkflowInputSnapshot.description: Frozen values, not an immutable file snapshot or an execution permission.

AutomationWorkflowInputs.description:
Explicit data-only mapping. Targets are typed workflow input pointers;
sources are pointers into the untrusted event object. No authority fields.

preview_format.description: Absent means the original /1 intake and its original byte bounds.

BrokerControllerRef.description:
Review identity of the current native FileBroker installation. Neither this
reference nor its generation authenticates a caller or qualifies a sandbox.

BuildHistoricalHistoryIndex.description: Explicitly derives a read-only index; no historical authority is activated.

ChatWorkflowSelection.description: A copied composer configuration, before runtime workspace/project instructions.

ConfigureAuditWitness.description:
Explicitly confirmed independent trust. The public pin never comes from a
checkpoint file itself. A replacement requires an original signed handover.

token.description: Write-only random 256-bit hexadecimal bearer. Only its digest is retained.

acknowledge_unknown.description:
Explicit containment acknowledgment allows a new configuration epoch
after a lost token response; it never replays that original exchange.

client_secret.description: Sent only to the private authenticated configuration route; never echoed.

ConfigureOfflineTools.description: Local device authority only. No team credential is transferred by this request.

environment.description: Write-only values. Omission preserves encrypted variables; an empty map clears them.

token.description: An empty token retains an existing credential, including while disabled.

bearer.description: None preserves existing auth; an empty string explicitly removes it.

ConfigureTeamProvider.description: Input-only. Deliberately no Debug implementation and never returned by GET.

ConfirmOwnerManagedResultDelivery.description: Confirms exactly the intent previously displayed by the controller.

native_tools.description: Explicit owner-native adapters. Empty preserves existing capability scope.

DiscoverProviderModels.description:
Read-only catalogue lookup before a provider or model has been saved.
Credentials are used for this request only, never persisted or returned.

DocumentActionRequest.description: A model-free document action. The server freezes all source hashes before review.

DocumentProvenance.description: Which built-in document tool produced a generated file, from which exact inputs.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine receipt that listed the published bytes.

DocumentProvenanceInput.description: One SHA-verified input copy that a document engine read.

DownloadMetadata.description: Metadata sent with an authenticated binary response, validated again by the client.

EffectiveAgentConfig.description: Copied prompt/generation values. Existing run fields hold execution authority.

ExecutionBoundary.description: Process networking does not describe model or connector data transmission.

input_snapshot_bound.description:
False until an immutable input snapshot, rather than live folder grants,
is actually bound by the selected adapter. Never inferred from a cwd.

programs.description: Exact package-relative programs in the qualified environment.

ExecutionInputRef.description: An immutable content reference, never a transfer or execution credential.

actor.description:
This owner API is authenticated by the installation's owner authority.
Team/device adapters must supply their own authenticated actor binding.

entries.description: Retained manifest for a directory; regular-file contents use before.sha256.

oneOf.description: A new file or directory published by a built-in document tool; never a replacement.

order_id.description: Present only for a managed working directory, never an external grant.

activated_parts.description: Current validated ledger status, separate from immutable catalogue bytes.

editable_selection_closed.description: A completed legacy import cannot acquire new editable mappings.

rowid.description: Decimal text preserves every original signed 64-bit rowid in JavaScript.

HistorySnapshot.description: Original IDs and ownership are retained in this immutable historical context.

ImportActorModelQualification.description: Native-only operator import. Actor credentials are transient headers, never fields.

expected_sha256.description: Null permits creation only; replacement requires the observed target hash.

confirmed_issuer_origin.description: Trusted native transfer must prove HTTPS origin or obtain native pin confirmation.

relation.description: contains, tagged, or cites. These are structural links, not factual claims.

via.description: Direct match or the explicit tag/source node used to reach this document.

KnowledgeLocation.description: Omitted on an edit = retain the current location; null folder = unfile.

LibraryConfigContract.description: Registers all library wire types with the shared generated contract.

ManageSandboxSession.description:
Only an existing project environment can be selected. No host paths, namespaces,
manifests or execution rights are accepted from the caller.

effects_unknown.description: Protocol cancellation and failure do not establish physical no-effect.

connection_id.description: Local connection nonce, not the secret MCP-Session-Id header.

oneOf.description: Admission was committed. Neither remote execution nor its absence is proven.

shared_team_consent.description: Explicit shared integration consent applies only to a Team profile.

credential_reference.description: Identifier only; native credential material must never be supplied here.

McpToolBinding.description: A frozen, explicitly selected remote tool. Credentials never enter this record.

McpToolSelection.description: A human-selected reference. The daemon resolves and freezes its definition.

request_sha256.description: Absent for imported preview history whose exact request was not recorded.

ModelCapabilities.description: What the configured model accepts besides text. Frozen into each run with its profile.

image_input.description: The model accepts images (vision); document previews and edited images are shown to it.

NativeAuthTransportRequest.description: Only the paired local native bridge transports this credential-bearing request.

NativeFolderSelection.description: Native-only request. Never accepted using the browser's daemon credential alone.

environment.description: Variable names and encrypted credential revisions only. Never plaintext values.

NativeSecretsStatus.description: Contains no native key locator or secret material.

OfflineMcpInteractionPage.description:
Explicit keyset pages keep full original server requests and samples within
the private Native IPC response bound. No record bytes are abbreviated.

OrderExport.description: A reviewable conversation export, not an executable migration package.

OwnerConnector.description: Secret-free connector metadata. Destination paths and bearer material are write-only.

oneOf.description:
Select the operator-registered runner. The controller resolves its current
identity and revision; this selector supplies no runner credentials.

Use the installed bounded document engine on the confirmed local copy.
This is an explicit process destination, not a process-free broker grant.

OwnerManagedResultDeliveryView.description: A private native acknowledgement is projected only as scoped display data.

version.description: None means no local reception intent, not a promise of remote availability.

entries.description: Complete for this run, bounded to 128 attempts. Larger runs return an error.

OwnerTerminalLaunch.description: Owner host execution only. No actor or model authorization is implied.

charged_units.description: Confirmed measurement plus pending and conservative unknown exposure.

confirmed_attempts.description: Counts keep zero-priced incomplete attempts visible.

overrun.description: Received tokens exceeded an original reservation bound.

oneOf.description: Historical explicitly bound runs remain protected without shared config.

folder_ids.description: Existing local folder capabilities, resolved by the broker. No host path.

committed_run_id.description: Receipt metadata is outside the immutable plan hash.

canonical_json.description:
Exact sorted JSON bytes hashed by the custodian. Clients verify these
without reformatting floating-point values or arbitrary input objects.

expected_public_key_sha256.description: Required for a V2 archive: obtain this pin independently from its origin.

history_only_file_ids.description: Every missing physical source must be explicitly retained as history or supplied through native staging.

oneOf.description: Launch permission was committed. This does not prove the process actually started.

ProcessInvocation.description: The environment and managed working directory come from the frozen run, not the model.

process_id.description: Diagnostic only. A PID by itself is not a runner identity or a reconciliation proof.

capabilities.description: Omitted when empty so existing profile hashes stay unchanged.

ReadWorkspaceTransferChunk.description:
A chunk is always read through an authenticated source order/run, never by a
global content hash alone. The expected hash is an integrity check, not a grant.

finish_cancellation.description:
Close the interrupted run as canceled in the same commit as settlement.
This does not change the original physical process termination evidence.

canonical_path.description: Human native grant manager only; not sent to models as folder context.

restore.description: The server fills the exact retained-content hash before review.

expected_source_sha256.description:
Optional for legacy receipts. Confirmed copy restoration binds this
server-resolved hash and checks it again before reading retained bytes.

file_action.description: A native file action runs through the same durable policy/tool path, without a model.

RunWorkspaceBinding.description:
Logical namespace of a run's private working copies. Native directory IDs
and materialization receipts remain in local private custody.

recover_only.description: Recover a previously staged request without resupplying secrets.

ScheduleOccurrence.description: Original occurrence content is evidence; returning it never dispatches it.

oneOf.description:
Monday = 1, Sunday = 7. Ambiguous local times use their first occurrence;
nonexistent DST times are skipped, never shifted to another wall time.

operator_chain_transition.description: True only after an explicit independent operator permits this new chain.

StructuredOutput.description:
Frozen with the exact request and provider. This constrains the final answer,
while intermediate tool calls continue through their existing approvals.

event_id.description: Stable sender identifier. Reuse with different data is a conflict.

legacy_location_adoption.description: An inspected current location, never a claim about an unknown old host.

effects_unknown.description: Retirement does not prove what the old tool did before it stopped.

TeamExecutionActor.description:
The currently available TeamService content-authority binding. The project
resource is scoped by the organization. No invented installation/device epoch
is accepted here; the executor/receiver target requires its own plan binding.

TeamExecutionPreflight.description:
A Team preflight must describe the real LiteLLM/team scope. It must not
masquerade as an owner Single preflight with native folders or credentials.

TeamMcpServer.description: Metadata only. Credentials are accepted solely by the write DTOs below.

personal_knowledge.description:
Also supply the account-wide memories (personal knowledge base) of the person
starting the run, frozen at admission. Requires the administrator's separate
approval because results the team reads may then contain private content.
Omitted when false, so request hashes of earlier runs stay unchanged.

incomplete.description: Reported totals are partial when any request has no complete measurement.

WorkflowBinding.description: Frozen binding to a private native workflow plan stored with this run.

inputs.description: Explicit run input, frozen with this binding; never tool authority.

WorkflowDataContext.description: Frozen per-model-step input boundary. Legacy definitions retain their context.

data.description: Incomplete editor values are durable; publication validates a separate definition.

WorkflowInputResumePreview.description: Read-only expectations for an explicit continuation. This view grants no authority.

canonical_json.description: Exact canonical native JSON; browsers must not parse and reserialize it.

manager_step_id.description:
A fixed manager step runs once after all declared worker steps.
Omission preserves the existing bounded dynamic-delegation contract.

oneOf.description: The accepted configuration is a frozen receipt, not the mutable current state.
Acceptance queues one generation; it does not confirm a human answer.

current_workspace.description: Source selection only; compiled execution rights contain concrete IDs.

role_id.description: Native document actions have no model role. Existing roles serialize unchanged.

expected_binding.description: An expectation to compare, never authority to grant rights.

input_source.description: Immutable original input, resolved only by the confirmed PlanV2 path.

WorkflowSnapshot.description:
Read-only archival data. Never accepted as workflow grants or IO authority.
The Rust domain validates these private checkpoint bodies on export/import.

WorkflowUnresolvedEffect.description: Aggregate schema root keeps the legacy definitions and adds public workflow contracts.

sha256.description: None denotes a directory; file entries include their content hash.

expected_sha256.description: Null means create-only. Existing files always require their observed SHA-256.

description: Contract-generation root. Every public request/response is reachable from this type.
title: ApiContractV2
